name: hintwise
description: Hintwise: AI that helps you think, not copy. Root scripts only (apps install independently).

scripts.setup: npm install && npm --prefix apps/api install && npm --prefix apps/web install
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm --prefix apps/api run start:dev" "npm --prefix apps/web start"
scripts.build: npm --prefix apps/api run build && npm --prefix apps/web run build
